mp4-muxer 5.2.2 by Vanilagy, MIT license (LICENSE).
Upstream: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mp4-muxer
Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mp4-muxer@5.2.2/build/mp4-muxer.mjs

mp4-muxer.js is a byte-for-byte copy of the ESM distribution, with a .js
extension because the supplied Windows Python playtest server serves .mjs as
text/plain. No upstream code was modified. The older jsquash-jxl vendor tree is
untouched. This pinned muxer is only used for the single H.264 video track.
